skills.name: Concerto Arte: Rush Attack
lines: Fire type piercing attack on all enemies (XL, x3.5)
* Increase strength the lower the target's HP rate (max x1.5) 1+(0.5×(1-EnemyHP%))
* Replaces the basic attack and requires both Alphen and Shionne to be in frontline
* Unlocks in Another Force at 200% Combo
** Once used, need to reach next threshold in Another Force combo to use again.
** Multiple uses will not stack if multiple thresholds are reached without using it.
